title: Simulate Claim
intro: Estimate your reimbursement using live cover pool sizes and prices. Settlement recalculates everything in the TEE, so the final payout may differ.

insuredToken.label: Insured Token
insuredToken.help: The token you claim for. Its max coverage sets the loss cap, and a cover pool holding this same token is excluded from its incident.

lossValue.label: Loss Value (USD)
lossValue.help: Value of the insured tokens you claim for, at the 7-day average price before the drop. The loss cap is a percentage of this value.

scoreWeight.label: Your Score Weight
scoreWeight.help: Your insurance score, including boosters, as a share of all claimants' scores in the same incident.
